s01EA19.name: Spawn item from sprite; Yoshi on-Mario update
summary: $01EA19 (long wrapper, called from bank $02) / $01EA21: spawns a sprite at the current sprite's position with sprite number $14, or $21 (moving coin, palette 2) while the Silver POW timer is running. Status 8, Y speed $D8, X speed +/-$10 toward Mario. Returns with no effect if there is no free slot.
$01EA70 (long entry from the Mario handler at $00E2C6): runs only if a Yoshi slot is registered in [$18E2] (slot + 1). Sets [$15E9] to Yoshi's slot, runs CODE_01EA8F and restores [$15E9].
CODE_01EA8F: picks Yoshi's pose index [$1602] (walk cycle, jump, turn, tongue, pipe) and, while Mario rides him (state [$C2] = 1), snaps Yoshi to Mario's position and falls into BackOnYoshi.
Quirk: pose numbers are used as indices into the tile/offset tables below (0 stand, 1-2 walk, 3 turn, 4 duck/look down, 5 rising, 6-7 tongue, 8-9 in pipe, $0A-$0C growing); meanings are inferred.

BackOnYoshi.name: Mark Mario as riding Yoshi
summary: Stores [RAM_OnYoshi] (1, or 2 when pose = 3), flags the overworld as having Yoshi, copies Yoshi's palette to [RAM_YoshiColor] and sets Mario's direction opposite to Yoshi's sprite direction.
Then draws Yoshi through HandleOffYoshi (the graphics routine) with [$64] set to $10 while Yoshi is in a pipe, restoring [$64] afterwards.

s01EBB4.name: Table: X offsets for sprite spawning

Yoshi.name: Yoshi sprite main routine
summary: Clears the per-frame flags, copies the wings flag to [RAM_YoshiHasWingsB], clears stomp. If status is not 8 (normal) it just draws and clears the overworld Yoshi flag.

Handles growing (timer [$18E8] picks the pose via GrowingAniSequence and locks sprites), the swallow/egg spit timer [$18DE] (spawns sprite $2C, status 9, from Yoshi's mouth), then physics, Mario-contact mounting (SetOnYoshi) and dismounting.

s01EC5B.name: Table: X speed and offsets for spat sprite

s01EC61.name: Yoshi physics, mounting and dismount
summary: $01EC61: Yoshi movement and Mario contact. If Mario is not on Yoshi, applies gravity and object collisions, builds a small hitbox at Yoshi's saddle and tests contact with Mario.
Mounting requires Mario in the air, falling, not carrying anything and not already on Yoshi.
$01ED70: while ridden, handles turning (timer [$15AC] = $10) and dismount on pressing X/Y ([$18] bit 7) or when [$13F3] is set. Dismounting launches Mario upward and gives Yoshi Mario's X speed.
$01EDCC/$01EDCE: sets Mario's Y position from Yoshi's Y minus a table offset (Y = 0 off Yoshi, 1 on Yoshi).

SetOnYoshi.name: Put Mario on Yoshi
summary: Called when Mario lands on Yoshi's back: positions Mario on him, zeroes Mario's speed, sets Yoshi state 1 (ridden), plays sounds, spawns a smoke effect and starts a $20-frame timer.
